value.rationale: A sharp quantitative ultraviolet divergence coefficient for a natural Wigner-negativity observable, with exact decomposition into coherent pair interference and a sharp N-dependent maximum. The phase/location independence and unbounded linear growth with pulse count distinguish the result from generic single square-well logarithmic divergence or cross-term identities. The necessity of midpoint separation is explicitly motivated, and the invariant controls the whole class rather than arbitrary narrow instances.
